# CanvasPlanet

> CanvasPlanet is a free, persistent, collaborative pixel-art canvas layered over a map of the real world. Everyone paints on the same canvas, one pixel at a time, and the canvas has no scheduled resets.

CanvasPlanet is a browser-based creative game at https://canvasplanet.net/. An account is optional. Painting uses a charge bank that refills over time; charges cannot be bought, sold, or transferred. Pixels are shared, so anyone can repaint any unprotected location.

## Product

- [About CanvasPlanet](https://canvasplanet.net/about.html): Canonical overview, how painting works, key features, and answers to common questions.
- [Live Canvas](https://canvasplanet.net/): The interactive world map and shared pixel canvas.
- [Service Status](https://status.canvasplanet.net/): Current availability and 90-day uptime history.

## Policies and contact

- [Terms of Service](https://canvasplanet.net/terms.html): Rules for painting, accounts, automation, moderation, embeds, and exports.
- [Privacy Policy](https://canvasplanet.net/privacy.html): Data collection, cookies, account deletion, and third-party services.
- [Support](mailto:support@canvasplanet.net): Product questions, content reports, and security disclosures.

## Important facts

- CanvasPlanet is free and has no paid tier, in-app purchases, or payment mechanism.
- Visitors can paint without creating an account.
- The shared canvas is persistent and has no scheduled resets.
- Painting automation, bots, scripts, and macros are prohibited.
- The public canvas can be viewed as a flat map or a 3D globe.
- Read-only embeds, image exports, and timelapse exports are available through the interface.
